item.title: Parents’ Night Out
item.description: Parents’ Night Out is for parents looking for a Valentine’s week plan for children ages 6–12. Taking place Friday, Feb. 13.

item.title: Science Museum Oklahoma Turns Back the Clock with SMO21+: 90s Rewind
item.description: Science Museum Oklahoma is turning back the clock with SMO21+: 90s Rewind, an adults-only after-hours event on Friday, Feb. 27, 2026. The evening invites guests 21 and over to explore the kid-free museum with hands-on activities, themed games, and nostalgic fun inspired by the 1990s.

item.title: Celebrate Founder’s Day at Science Museum Oklahoma with Any Donation in Lieu of Admission on Feb. 9
item.description: We are celebrating the day as an opportunity to both honor its founder and educate the community about the museum’s nonprofit status. In lieu of regular admission throughout the day, Science Museum Oklahoma will take donations to support its mission and provide hands-on science learning for the community.

item.title: Storm Safety Day
item.description: Storm Safety Day prepares Oklahomans on Spring Break. Science Museum Oklahoma and FOX25 team up to promote weather preparedness.

item.title: NBA Foundation Awards Science Museum Oklahoma Grant to Expand Teen Apprentice Program
item.description: Science Museum Oklahoma has been awarded a generous grant from the NBA Foundation to support and expand its Teen Apprentice Program.

item.title: Science Museum Oklahoma to Reopen Beloved Mighty Mouth on Feb. 23
item.description: Science Museum Oklahoma to reopen beloved Mighty Mouth on Feb. 23. Delta Dental of Oklahoma funds the newly imagined exhibition.

item.title: Science Museum Oklahoma Launches New smART Talks Series with International Artist Jonty Hurwitz
item.description: Saturday, March 28, 2026, from 4:30 to 6:30 p.m. featuring internationally recognized artist Jonty Hurwitz. Free and open to the public.

item.title: Teens Lead the Way at Science Museum Oklahoma This Spring with the Teen Apprentice Program and SMOTeens
item.description: This spring join us at SMOTeens Saturday, April 11, 2026, and applications are now open for Teen Apprentice program through March 31.
